title: Software Engineer
overview: Design, develop, and maintain software applications and systems. It involves writing code, debugging, and collaborating with cross-functional teams.
roadmap: Learn a programming language (e.g., Python or JavaScript)
Master Data Structures and Algorithms
Build basic projects (e.g., to-do list, weather app)
Learn Version Control (Git) and contribute to Open Source
Apply for internships

title: Data Scientist
overview: Analyze and interpret complex data to help organizations make better decisions. Combines statistics, computer science, and domain expertise.
roadmap: Master Mathematics (Linear Algebra, Calculus, Statistics)
Learn Python and its data libraries (Pandas, NumPy)
Learn SQL for data extraction
Understand and apply basic Machine Learning algorithms
Build a portfolio with real-world datasets

title: UI/UX Designer
overview: Focus on the user experience and interface design of digital products, ensuring they are intuitive, accessible, and visually appealing.
roadmap: Learn design principles (Color, Typography, Layout)
Master design tools like Figma
Study User Experience (UX) laws and psychology
Create wireframes and interactive prototypes
Publish case studies to a portfolio

title: Mechanical Engineer
overview: Design, analyze, manufacture, and maintain mechanical systems. Ranges from robotics to automotive and aerospace.
roadmap: Strong foundation in Physics and Mathematics
Learn CAD software during college
Participate in technical competitions (e.g., SAE Baja, Formula Student)
Secure an industrial internship
Specialize in an area (e.g., Thermal, Design, Robotics)
